title: $APP Wyckoff and Post Earnings Analysis
author: One-Cellist-8159
selftext:
AppLovin Corp. engages in the development and operation of a mobile marketing platform. It offers AppDiscovery, MAX, Adjust, and SparkLabs. Its software-based platform caters to mobile application developers to improve the marketing and monetization of applications.

When I am combining Earnings for Q1, Q2 and Wyckoff structure decoded using EdgeCipher, I am now able to see. SV here stands for Stopping volume - heavy selling met by buyers.

According to the tool,  
What the volume says

Most trading happened around $477.44 — that's the price the market has agreed on most. About 70% of all volume sits between $377.95 and $548.50. Heavy-volume shelves (likely support/resistance) sit near $392.16, $430.06, $477.44.

* Stopping volume · 2026-07-31 — Stopping volume — 2.7× average volume on a push to new lows, but the bar closed 89% up its range: heavy selling met by buyers.
* No-demand rally · 2026-08-03 — No-demand up bar — price ticked up on only 68% of average volume with a narrow range: buyers are not committing at these prices.

However it has dropped after an outstanding ER. which i think is very likely going to produce classic C Spring or TS candle tomorrow based on how i see the Wyckoff accumulation structure and analysis from EdgeCipher. keep it on high watch tomorrow.
